criteria.statement: the index artifact is decompressed and parsed fully once, at first use, holding its byte-offset directory in memory
a lookup for one variant's detail reads only that variant's byte range and gunzips only that slice
a test proves a corrupt neighbor's bytes never prevent decompressing an adjacent variant's bytes, proving per-member independence directly rather than via a call-counter
a variant with a null steps/prerequisites/mana/card-state field fails integrity validation at lazy-decompression time, for that variant only
missing, empty, or malformed index or detail artifacts disable combo enrichment only, warning once per process/path
COMBO_ENRICHMENT_ENABLED=false suppresses the loader entirely; the index is never read
repeated lookups for the same variant do not unboundedly retain every seen variant's decompressed detail
